nodes.label: Renamed LocalHook AI to Callback Forensics
nodes.rationale: Renamed mid-build per instruction: binary cbf (alias callback-forensics), packages @cbf/*, config ~/.cbf, env CBF_*, relay path /cb/:id/*.

nodes.label: Standalone repo location choice
nodes.rationale: Built outside the OneDrive-synced StemHackathon monorepo because OneDrive syncing node_modules and SQLite files is slow/fragile; instructed to git init a clean repo.

nodes.label: ESM + TypeScript via tsx
nodes.rationale: Workspace packages point main at src/index.ts with no build step; node --import tsx used for child processes and Docker CMD.

nodes.label: util.parseArgs instead of commander
nodes.rationale: Node built-in, one fewer dependency.

nodes.label: Dashboard as one static HTML file
nodes.rationale: Vanilla JS/CSS served by the CLI on 127.0.0.1 only; a Host/Origin check blocks cross-site and DNS-rebinding requests to replay endpoints.

nodes.label: Relay delivery semantics
nodes.rationale: delivered=1 means CLI responded; 25s timeout yields 504 and is not re-flushed; queued events flush in order on connect; socket drop yields 202 queued:true (at-least-once delivery); newer WebSocket replaces older with close code 4000.

nodes.label: TRUST_PROXY defaulting rationale
nodes.rationale: Defaults to 1 for the per-IP tunnel limit; correct value on App Platform is unverified.

nodes.label: Raw byte forwarding
nodes.rationale: express.raw({type:()=>true}) on the public route; CLI forwards Buffer bodies and only rewrites Host and recomputes Content-Length, preserving HMAC signature validity.

nodes.label: Diagnosis triggers on status >= 400
nodes.rationale: Spec said both 4xx/5xx and >=500; the superset keeps 4xx covered, and the AI step is serialized so a burst of failures cannot hammer the model.

nodes.label: Routing problems skip the model
nodes.rationale: HTTP 404/405, or no stderr and no stack frame, yields one routing finding and no model call; the no-stderr case only applies when the CLI is capturing the app's stderr, otherwise forward-only mode would mislabel every 500.

nodes.label: Connection failures skip the model
nodes.rationale: There is nothing to explain; the rule-based note says the app was unreachable.

nodes.label: Shared AI cache
nodes.rationale: ~/.cbf/ai-cache.db (CBF_CACHE overrides) so demo:warm can warm it for later runs; stores only real model text, failures never cached; tests write to in-memory DBs only.

nodes.label: Prompt determinism
nodes.rationale: Stack frames rendered relative to source root, limited to application frames, so the same failure produces the same prompt and cache key under tsx watch or tsx.

nodes.label: Local store retention
nodes.rationale: Local store keeps the last 1000 events, pruned at startup.

nodes.label: Demo handlers/fixes/broken directory split
nodes.rationale: Handlers live in packages/demo/handlers/ (not app/) so fixes in packages/demo/fixes/ use identical relative imports and copy over verbatim; pristine broken copies live in packages/demo/broken/ for demo:reset.

nodes.label: HMAC signature verification over raw body
nodes.rationale: Demo app verifies GitHub/HubSpot-style X-Hub-Signature-256 and Stripe-style Stripe-Signature but ignores signature timestamps, so replay works at any time; real Stripe libraries enforce a tolerance (documented limitation).

nodes.label: truth.json keyword groups
nodes.rationale: Written before any model was run; groups require the field name and problem type with synonyms listed up front; must not be edited to make a model pass.

nodes.label: Rule-based scoring uses diff + error line
nodes.rationale: Often passes by itself because the diff names the field; that is reported, not hidden.

nodes.label: demo:warm command
nodes.rationale: Runs the real pipeline in-process (relay, CLI agent, demo app, model) and leaves real answers in the cache; a no-op for caching if no model server is running.

nodes.label: dev:all uses separate CBF_HOME
nodes.rationale: Uses .cbf-dev/ and a separate relay database so it never touches a real tunnel configured with cbf init; the sender prefers that dev tunnel when its relay is up.

nodes.label: oauth-redirect scenario completed
nodes.rationale: Core rules in packages/core/src/oauth.ts (four rules, GET only), a handler, fix, payloads, truth.json, unit tests, and README documentation of exactly which rules exist.

nodes.label: Graphify skill not installed, skipped
nodes.rationale: The graphify skill was not installed in this environment, so /graphify . was skipped and no graphify-out/ was committed; README has a hand-written Codebase map instead.

nodes.label: Things deliberately not done
nodes.rationale: No real DigitalOcean deploy, Docker build, GitHub webhook, or llama-server run happened in this environment; no pushing (no remote added).
